soundBlocked.title: 🔔 Notification sounds are paused
soundBlocked.body: Browsers only allow page sound after you click or type on the page. Click here to turn on desktop notifications: they ring even when Obelisk is in another tab.

relay.title: Connect to {host}?
relay.body: This link opens a relay you have not added. Connecting sends it your public key and lets it see your IP address. You can also stay where you are.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This page doesn't exist, or it moved.

analyticsConsent.title: Google Analytics
analyticsConsent.body: Can Obelisk use Google Analytics? It is only used to see how Obelisk is used. If you allow it, Google receives the pages you visit (inside the app, that includes which relay and channel you are in) and your approximate location, worked out from your IP address, and it stores a cookie with an identifier for this device. Nothing from Google loads unless you allow it. You can change your answer any time in Settings or at the bottom of the site's pages.
analyticsConsent.more: What Obelisk keeps on your device
